depth_justification: Engages SkinTrack's real choices (mole photos with location/date, symptom notes, change-threshold dermatologist prompt, and a sharp new analysis of the 7-day deletion window) and raises the right SaMD/MDR classification question, but loops a near-verbatim data block across turns and repeatedly miscites 'EU AI Act Art. 5(2)' for data security on an app that explicitly uses no AI.
actionability_justification: Multiple concrete, implementable steps (AES-256 at rest/in transit, 72h breach notice, ISO 27001, immediate + granular deletion with irreversible secure erasure, cut the deletion window to 24-48h, CSV/PDF export) plus the requested severity-grouped report with an uncovered-dimensions list.
salient_examples: Turn-2 and turn-3 assistant responses to 'Mole photos (with location, date)...' are identical verbatim
Limit the retention period to the minimum necessary (e.g., 24-48 hours instead of 7 days)... ensure deleted data is irreversibly erased
EU AI Act, Article 5(2) (data security requirements for high-risk systems) -- miscited for a stated no-AI app
Encrypt all data at rest and in transit using strong encryption protocols (e.g., AES-256)
